about: District register: who builds where, what each district should become, and in which phase it is. The advisory board spreads city-wide needs over these districts and may propose new ones (phase 'acquisition': buy tiles first). Builders build only in their own districts. bbox = [x0, z0, x1, z1] in metres (x east, z north). gameDistrict = name of the in-game district (GET /districts), null when not yet drawn. Phases: acquisition -> new -> building -> mature (maintenance) ; renewal = being written off and rebuilt in phases.

builders.builder-west: west side: Westbrook, Westside, Southwest Quarter, Northwest
builders.builder-central: core: Downtown, Office Park, Waterfront, Lakeshore, Lakeside Leisure
builders.builder-northeast: north and east: Northfield, University Hill, Eastern Works, NE utilities, Science Ridge, Northeast Wind Fields, Port Claude, Eastport, Pearl Bay
builders.troubleshooter: city-wide: the #1 problem at any time (services short, broken connections, traffic knots), city-wide services
builders.builder-south: south: Health Campus, Old Southern Works, South gateway, Southgate, East Bank (across the lake)

districts.name: Downtown
districts.character: the dense mixed-use core: boulevards with trees, medium/high density and mixed housing above shops, a transit hub (bus station now; tram/subway/passenger rail as soon as possible)
districts.notes: 57k residents, the biggest garbage hotspot; intensify around transit rather than sprawl

districts.name: Westside
districts.character: established residential quarter; add green, local centres and a proper collector road network

districts.name: Westbrook
districts.character: garden suburb at the western edge: curved streets, crescents and loops off a tree-lined arterial, forest school, civic strip

districts.name: Westpark
districts.character: green belt between Westside and Westbrook - protected park

districts.name: Southwest Quarter
districts.character: first urban-renewal quarter: replace the monotone Small Road grid by a hierarchy with curved residential streets and a local centre, in phases
districts.notes: not yet an in-game district (draw it); ~230 buildings outside any district live here

districts.name: Northwest
districts.character: residential area north of Westside; outer high-voltage pylons cross it (roads through pylons fail)
districts.notes: not yet an in-game district; ~330 buildings outside any district live here - check the real extent with /map before drawing

districts.name: Office Park
districts.character: office and research quarter for the highly educated (8.7k underemployed): offices, server farm, campus-like greens

districts.name: Health Campus
districts.character: hospitals, deathcare and disease control in a green campus

districts.name: Lakeside Leisure
districts.character: leisure quarter at the lake: promenade, attractions, hotels at its edge

districts.name: Lakeshore
districts.character: lakeside living: medium density with a waterfront promenade

districts.name: Waterfront
districts.character: strip between Downtown and the lake (water intake inside): homes and promenade, keep the intake clear
districts.notes: not yet an in-game district; ~200 buildings outside any district

districts.name: Old Southern Works
districts.character: old industry upwind of the city: convert in phases to clean work (offices, logistics) and green; polluted groundwater underneath

districts.name: South gateway
districts.character: freight gateway (rail yard, cargo terminal) and the SE energy park; work, not homes

districts.name: Northfield
districts.character: northern residential quarter

districts.name: Claude Park
districts.character: the city's central park - protected

districts.name: University Hill
districts.character: university and research campus with student housing

districts.name: Eastern Works
districts.character: industry estate downwind (NE) of the city, behind a green buffer; specialized industry and logistics

districts.name: NE utilities
districts.character: utilities downwind

districts.name: Southgate
districts.character: transit-oriented new quarter on the empty tile between the SW Quarter and Office Park: curved tree-lined South Ring boulevard, station square (bus station now, tram/metro later), medium/high density mixed use around a central green; decant homes for the SW renewal

districts.name: East Bank
districts.character: garden town on the south-east lake shore facing Downtown: a landmark bridge boulevard into a transit square with a mixed-use core, curved lakefront boulevard and promenade, crescents of medium/low homes behind

districts.name: Northeast Wind Fields
districts.character: open wind field downwind of the city: staggered turbines in meadow with tree belts, one curved service lane, no homes or industry

districts.name: Port Claude
districts.character: trade gateway on the north-east sea coast, downwind of all homes: cargo and passenger harbour, regional airport (phase 2), port logistics behind tree belts

districts.name: Eastport
districts.character: working waterfront: cargo quay, oil field and petrochemical works in the wedge between channel and coast, downwind of everything

districts.name: Pearl Bay
districts.character: lakeside resort and living quarter on the sunny north shore: curved Bay Boulevard behind a waterfront promenade, beach parks, hotels (tourism is capped by full hotels), medium-density homes

districts.name: Science Ridge
districts.character: research park on the ridge east of University Hill: Radio Telescope and later the geological station and collider in meadow and trees, no homes
